title: Cannot add System and User Environment variables with the same name to one Profile in "Environment variables" Util
author: MayMih
summary: Environment Variables profiles cannot contain same-name User and System entries because profile application currently writes variables into one effective user-variable namespace.
next_action: Reclassify as a profile-scope enhancement and define privileged System-variable application semantics before reviving implementation.

confidence.rationale: The maintainer explicitly states the current namespace model and labels the requested behavior an improvement.

judgment.rationale: A maintainer confirms this is expected behavior and describes broader namespace support as a planned improvement; an attempted PR was later closed without merge.
evidence: The reporter cannot select both User Path and System Path, or both User and System TMP, in one profile.
A maintainer explains that profile variables are applied as user variables, so duplicate names would override each other.
Closed unmerged PR #48932 attempted same-name cross-namespace handling, showing implementation work was explored but is not an existing shipped fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Reclassify as a profile-scope enhancement and define privileged System-variable application semantics before reviving implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current behavior is intentional under user-scope profiles; system-scope profile application is a separate enhancement.

issue_context.summary: Environment Variables profiles cannot contain same-name User and System entries because profile application currently writes variables into one effective user-variable namespace.
known_information: The original affected version is PowerToys 0.75.0.
The user's goal is to switch both User and System TMP values together.
The current issue discussion explicitly treats the limitation as expected behavior.
inferences: Supporting both scopes requires retaining namespace in profile identity and defining elevation, rollback, and conflict behavior when applying System variables.
issue_context.analysis: This is not a duplicate-name validation bug under the current user-only profile model; it is a new system-scope capability with security and UX implications.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and all maintainer comments.
Fetched closed unmerged PR #48932 and confirmed it proposed cross-namespace handling but is not an active or merged fix.

actions.label: Reclassify as profile scope enhancement

comment.body: Environment Variables profiles currently apply entries as user variables, so allowing both User and System variables with the same name would collapse them into one effective name and overwrite a value. Please track this as a profile-scope enhancement rather than a duplicate-name bug. A design should preserve scope in identity and define elevation, rollback, conflict, and partial-failure behavior for System-variable updates; closed PR #48932 is prior implementation context, not a shipped fix.
